citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 3:30 pm on July 23,
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone call and text, leaving messages for the licensee. The
license called back at 4:25 pm stating he was unable to accompany the inspector for an inspection. Failure to provide
access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to
provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section

2.126(b) 
   
Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 3:30 pm on July 23, 
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by phone call and text, leaving messages for the licensee. The 
license called back at 4:25 pm stating he was unable to accompany the inspector for an inspection. Failure to provide 
access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to 
provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action. 
 
 
End Section
